newsitem.title: UK: English China up as market hails outlook.
newsitem.headline: English China up as market hails outlook.

text.p: Shares in English China Clays Plc soared on Friday following a positive trading statement from the building materials group, dealers said.
By 0952 GMT the shares were up 24p, or 13 percent, to 211p, making the mid-cap company the second biggest gainer in volume of 1.5 million shares.
"The figures were quite good. The market was pleased with the outlook", one dealer said.
Earlier the company said sales were up and profits margins in all its operations had improved "considerably" in the first five months because of cost cutting.
